sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean source build succeeds with MPI wrapper; --restart is ignored, completed output contract is missing, and restart_final.dat would contain a placeholder.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Python CGNS/HDF5 reader handles zones and TRI/QUAD/BAR sections and builds face graph; centroid is a vertex average and global face count undercounts boundary edges.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Rusanov and wall/farfield source exist, but main.cpp:40,52,55 mishandles edge-length-scaled normals in acoustic dissipation and slip reflection.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares linear gradients and bounded limiter/positivity fallback exist locally; partition-ghost face state is first order and no smooth-order evidence is delivered.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian-like stress, heat term, wall states and tangential force split are present; unfinished histories provide no validated laminar evidence.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Local diagonal update contains BDF physical-time terms, but inner target and line search assess spatial residual alone; no completed transient run.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: PyMETIS preprocessing, owned/ghost mesh, neighbor state exchange and reductions are implemented; no completed rank comparison or ghost reconstruction exchange.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Only two partial histories without metadata; six required cases absent, including Re200.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: No production report or approved main PDF; smoke report is a diagnostic rather than the required case report.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Configuration and Python tools exist, but 2-D solver/EOS/source are monolithic with limited generalization.
